summary: Backend-only full lifecycle testing of Pinaki Solutions CRM. Wrote a comprehensive pytest suite (test_lifecycle.py) covering auth (login/me/logout/lockout, wrong password), clients (list/create/detail), orders CRUD with auto PS-YYMM-XX ID and 18% GST, full lifecycle enforcement (production locked before approval 409, dispatch locked before production 409, invoice locked before delivery 409), design->approval flow (rejection returns to Design, approval moves to Production), production status transitions (In Progress, Completed -> Dispatch), dispatch auto-creating CH-YYMM-XX challan and setting In Transit, delivery -> Accounts stage, INV-YYMM-XX invoice generation, partial + full payment updating invoice status/outstanding, GridFS document upload/list/download, notifications for design/production/accounts roles, global /api/search, /api/reports, and RBAC (sales blocked from production 403, production blocked from dispatch 403, accounts can post invoice after delivery). Result: 31/32 tests PASS. Only failure is a seed data gap (CL-1003 Svelte Interiors missing from db.clients — likely deleted by prior test iterations; seed runs only when collection empty).

minor.issue: Seed inserts clients only when db.clients is empty. Prior sessions removed CL-1003 (Svelte Interiors) so it is no longer restored on restart. Consider upsert-by-client_id for demo clients so the three seeded companies always exist.

action_items: Re-seed CL-1003 Svelte Interiors client (either manually or by making startup seed idempotent per client_id).

Note: Tests must be executed with -p no:xdist (or serially) because the module-scoped order_flow fixture carries state across ordered tests; pytest-xdist splits classes across workers and breaks the flow. Consider adding `-p no:xdist` to backend/pytest.ini addopts for reliable lifecycle test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 763 lines in a single file — split into routers (auth, orders, lifecycle, invoices, documents, reports) for maintainability.
create_delivery accepts admin/dispatch/accounts. Aligned with spec but be aware sales cannot mark delivery.
dashboard/reports do full-collection scans with in-Python aggregation — fine at seed scale but will not scale; move to Mongo aggregation pipelines.
invoice list computes status per request; consider caching or an aggregate view for large data.
download_document reads full file into memory (data = await stream.read()) — for large files stream chunks instead.
Startup seed uses count == 0 gate; changes to seed structure won't apply to existing deployments (as evidenced by missing Svelte).
test_credentials: Seven roles seeded, all password Pinaki@123 (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Verified: admin, sales, design, production, dispatch, accounts.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_-prefixed clients and orders; no cleanup performed (safe because names/IDs are unique and namespaced).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_lifecycle.py -v -p no:xdist. All 32 lifecycle tests should pass once CL-1003 (Svelte Interiors) is re-seeded. Auth uses httpOnly cookies (secure+samesite=none) — use requests.Session for cookie persistence. CORS uses allow_origin_regex, credentials work. Login lockout after 5 failures / 15 min; clear via db.login_attempts.delete_many({}).
rca of the issue: Missing Svelte Interiors client (CL-1003): startup seed only inserts clients when db.clients.count_documents({}) == 0. In a previous iteration the client was likely removed by cleanup or manual deletion; the seed no longer re-adds it because the collection is not empty. Fix: use upsert-per-client_id in seed loop so idempotent restarts restore the three demo clients.
